item.title: Saint Mary's basketball ends season, fails to make MIAA tournament
item.description: The Saint Mary's basketball season came to a close this past week as they finished 8-17 overall and 3-13 in conference play. The two teams they went up against were Kalamazoo and Olivet. item.title: Notre Dame men's tennis nets mixed results in Big Ten weekend
item.description: After an impressive win against Illinois the week before, Notre Dame men's tennis turned up the difficulty this past weekend, taking on a fiery Northwestern team on Friday before traveling to Columbus to face No. 1 Ohio State. The Irish dominated the first duel of the weekend, sweeping Northwestern 4-0, but fell short against an impervious Buckeyes squad, losing 5-0 on Sunday. item.title: Major renovation nearly complete at Moreau Seminary and Scholasticate
item.description: A significant renovation is near completion at Moreau Seminary and Scholasticate, located on the opposite side of St. Joseph's Lake from the University. It is the seminary's first major refurbishment during its 75 years of operation - aside from minor upgrades made in 2001.Moreau opened in 1958 and has since been home to formation programs for vocations to the Congregation of Holy Cross. item.title: Solidarity SMC hosts panel on immigration as a pro-life issue
item.description: In the wake of heightened debate surrounding immigration in the United States, Solidarity SMC held a lecture-style event titled "Immigrant Rights are a Pro-Life Issue" Monday. item.title: Belles Unite Borders to march for solidarity with immigrants
item.description: Belles Unite Borders, a student club at Saint Mary's College, has begun advertising a peaceful protest for Tuesday, March 3 from 5 to 6 p.m., calling on Saint Mary's students to march in fellowship with immigrant groups.
